description: Correct a place already in the bank. Only the fields you pass change — everything else is carried over from what is banked, because the API replaces the whole row. Use this to fix a name, a role, or dates.

company.description: Company name, or the project's name.

current.description: True while the candidate is still there.

end.description: Same format as start; omit while ongoing.

id.description: The employment id, from experience_list. Opaque — read it, never construct one.

kind.description: "job" or "project"; defaults to job on create.

role.description: The candidate's title or role there.

start.description: A free-form date as it would be printed, e.g. "Mar 2021".

summary.description: One line about the place, for context.

name: experience_update_employment
